entries.title: Psalms 12:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.>> Help, Jehovah; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 12:2
segments: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbor: With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.

entries.title: Psalms 12:3
segments: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh great things;

entries.title: Psalms 12:4
segments: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; Our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

entries.title: Psalms 12:5
segments: Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; I will set him in the safety he panteth for.

entries.title: Psalms 12:6
segments: The words of Jehovah are pure words; As silver tried in a furnace on the earth, Purified seven times.

entries.title: Psalms 12:7
segments: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 12:8
segments: The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
